structured.answer: The cheapest account on the list is Pesagot (פסגות טרייד), about 1,058 ₪ over 10 years, but the page doesn't know any fund for my 'test' index and wants me to add one myself. So I don't know "how", and I'll ask my son before doing anything.

stuck.why: It says 'האתר לא אסף קרנות על test' and asks me to add a fund myself. I don't know which fund, and that's what I came to find out.

stuck.why: Empty. No fund and no cost, so there's no answer to 'how'.
To me מדד is the price index on the news. I wasn't sure this page was for me.

stuck.where: Second screen, long list with colored and red bars
